summary: Tested Milestone 2 P0 features: TipTap rich text editor + Media Upload/Serve/List/Delete. Found and fixed a critical TipTap runtime error. All 10 backend tests passing. Frontend editor rendering correctly after fix.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'cached') at DOMSerializer.fromSchema → Editor.getHTML(). The useEffect sync hook called editor.getHTML() on initial mount before TipTap/Table extension schema was fully initialized.
ui_bugs.priority: CRITICAL - was crashing the entire blog editor page

bugs_fixed.bug: useEffect sync hook called editor.getHTML() which threw 'Cannot read properties of null (reading cached)' due to TipTap Table extension schema initialization timing. Editor crashed on every page load.
bugs_fixed.fix: Wrapped editor.getHTML() in try-catch and added editor.isDestroyed guard. On catch, directly call setContent without comparison.

critical_code_review_comments: TipTap 3.26 + Table extension has a schema initialization race - the getHTML() call in useEffect was triggering before Table node type was registered. The try-catch fix is a workaround; root cause may be resolved by TipTap updating Table extension or by removing Table if not needed.

uploaded_by_id in media_routes.py stores raw ObjectId (current_user['_id']). If this field is serialized, it may cause issues. The _doc() helper doesn't recursively convert nested ObjectIds in media records.
seed_data_creation: 1 test PNG uploaded and deleted during backend testing (cleanup verified)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Milestone 2 features working: Media upload (PNG validated, type/size rejection working), media serve via /api/media/:filename, media list/get/delete, TipTap editor on /admin/blog/new and /admin/blog/:id. The TipTap editor bug was fixed with a try-catch in useEffect. Storage is real local filesystem at /app/backend/uploads/. 20 toolbar buttons visible in editor. All existing iteration_2 features remain working.
rca_of_issue: TipTap 3.26 Table extension registers its schema nodes asynchronously or lazily. When TipTapEditor mounts and the content useEffect fires immediately, editor.getHTML() calls DOMSerializer.fromSchema(schema) which iterates all node specs. The Table node spec's parseDOM contains a reference that is null at mount time. Fix: guard with try-catch, fallback to setContent directly.
